title: The Dark Dream Begins
overview: With the capital retaken and the Liones Kingdom slowly getting back on its feet, Meliodas, Elizabeth and Hawk turn their attention to the Boar Hat.

title: Our Fighting Festival
overview: Ban and Meliodas meet to continue the duel they left unfinished before, only to find that Hawk has told everyone about their solemn battle.

title: In Pursuit of First Love
overview: King is overjoyed to spend the day of the festival with Diane, but he's struggling to figure out how to take the next step.

title: The Shape of Love
overview: Business at the Boar Hat is dropping, so Meliodas asks Merlin to join the staff as a waitress alongside Elizabeth and Diane to attract customers.
